name: accounting-sustainability-quality
notes: 3-factor accounting sustainability: z(GP/TA) + z(-accruals) + z(-NOA). GP/TA (productive assets), low accruals (cash-backed earnings), low NOA (lean balance sheet). accruals = (NI-OCF)/TA; noa = (TA-CL)/TA. Direct test of 3-factor dilution vs H265 2-factor filtered quality (Sharpe 0.952).
